sentences.text:
Siyaram Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 January,
2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Jbp:466
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Himanshu Joshi

On The 6 th Of January, 2026
 Writ Petition No. 40191 of 2025
 Siyaram Yadav
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Vishal Daniel - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri Amit Garg - P.L. for the respondent/State.

Order 
An offence has been registered against the petitioner punishable under Section 420, 506 of IPC and Section 66D of the Information Technology Act.
Counsel for the State has admitted that arrest of the present petitioner is not required at present.
He has also admitted that petitioner has cooperated in the investigation.
No coercive steps has been taken against the petitioner.
Counsel for the petitioner also seeks permission to withdraw this petition with liberty to file a fresh petition if occasion so arises.
This petition is disposed of with the aforesaid liberty.
However, it is made clear that in respect of the particular crime number, no coercive steps be taken against the petitioner.
